stories.title: 美国肯塔基大学管理员获宗教豁免，可不在工作中使用 AI
stories.sourceTitle: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，肯塔基大学管理员 David Durman 以宗教理由获得工作场所使用 AI 的豁免。事件把 AI 引入职场后的个人信仰与员工权利争议推到台前。
stories.analysis: 职场 AI 强制使用若缺少豁免机制，可能引发更多宗教或价值观冲突。
stories.sourceExcerpt: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

stories.title: OpenAI 更新 Model Spec，提出五项核心价值引导更强 AI
stories.sourceTitle: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布更新版 Model Spec，用五项核心价值指导更强模型在判断力、人类能动性和遵循人类意图方面的行为。该规范为模型训练与对齐提供公开规则。
stories.analysis: 公开规范有助于外部审视对齐方向，但实际执行仍取决于训练与监控。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

stories.title: Jassy：AWS 将成为万亿美元业务，但先要大幅增加资本支出
stories.sourceTitle: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
stories.summary: Amazon CEO Jassy 表示 AWS 目标成为首个万亿美元营收业务，并称需继续大举投资 AI 云计算基础设施。资本开支力度是达成目标的前提。
stories.analysis: AI 云竞赛正把资本支出推到新高度，短期利润压力与长期份额争夺并存。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.

stories.title: 微软 AI 转型信号：Nadella 言论指向员工规模收缩
stories.sourceTitle: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
stories.summary: The Verge 指出，Satya Nadella 近期表态显示 AI 将从根本上改变微软员工规模。报道将此视为微软劳动力结构变化的最清晰信号。
stories.analysis: AI 对白领岗位的替代效应正在从预测进入企业人力调整。
stories.sourceExcerpt: To anyone listening closely to what Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has been saying over the past couple of years, this week felt like the clearest sign yet that AI is about to fundamentally change the size of Microsoft's workforce. Microsoft is now offering volun

stories.title: Gemini 聊天中可直接生成并编辑 Google Docs 等文件
stories.sourceTitle: You can generate and edit Google Docs files directly in Gemini chats now
stories.summary: Google Gemini 面向所有用户上线文件编辑能力，可在聊天中生成、预览和编辑 PDF、Google Docs、Sheets、幻灯片、Markdown、TXT 和代码。文件处理进一步并入 Gemini 对话工作流。
stories.analysis: 把文档编辑嵌入聊天会提升任务闭环，但也加剧 Gemini 与办公套件的绑定。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Now you can generate, preview, and edit PDFs, Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown files, TXT files, and code directly within Google Gemini. The new file editing capabilities are available starting today for all Gemini users, and while PDF preview

stories.title: Anthropic 递交 S-1，向华尔街讲述 AGI 叙事
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
stories.summary: The Verge 的 Decoder 节目邀请 SemiAnalysis 分析师 Joey Brookhart 解读 Anthropic 的 S-1 招股书，讨论其 IPO 文件中的数字与 AGI 叙事。核心是 Anthropic 如何让公开市场相信其长期愿景。
stories.analysis: 把 AGI 写进招股书意味着公司需要用资本故事支撑高算力投入。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Today on Decoder, I’m joined by Joey Brookhart, an analyst at the chip and AI research firm SemiAnalysis, to help me dig into the story inside the numbers of the Anthropic IPO filing — a document known as an S-1. Anthropic just filed its S-1 to go public on th

stories.title: Anthropic 商业计划被解读为“造神，或死在路上”
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
stories.summary: The Verge 分析 Anthropic 的 S-1，认为文件为其尽可能大举投入算力提供了财务理由。报道质疑 Anthropic 是否在全力打造“机器之神”的同时说服华尔街。
stories.analysis: 当算力投入被包装成使命，投资者需分辨愿景与可验证商业回报。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The Anthropic S-1 seems to have provided the financial justification for the company to spend as much as it possibly can on compute. If you are the kind of person who wonders if Anthropic is doing its level best to build a machine god while convincing Wall Str

stories.title: 搜索流量枯竭，Reddit 宣布转向登录体验
stories.sourceTitle: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
stories.summary: 随着 AI 改变人们在线查找信息的方式，Reddit 宣布调整开放网络策略，转向登录体验以保护用户和业务。此举反映 AI 搜索对内容平台流量模式的冲击。
stories.analysis: AI 摘要截流后，社区平台可能更依赖登录墙和自有关系来守住流量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

stories.title: Rivian 扩大与大众合资企业，纳入 AI 助手
stories.sourceTitle: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
stories.summary: Rivian 扩大与大众的合资业务范围，将 AI 助手纳入其中；报道未披露 58 亿美元合资企业的估值是否因此增加。合作从电动车平台延伸到车载 AI 功能。
stories.analysis: 传统车企与电动车企的合资正把软件和 AI 作为下一阶段竞争点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

stories.title: OpenAI 支持的 Thrive Holdings 以 153 亿美元收购 ADT
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
stories.summary: OpenAI 支持的 Thrive Holdings 以 153 亿美元收购 ADT，计划把 AI 引入家庭安防业务。交易显示 AI 资本正流向线下家庭服务场景。
stories.analysis: AI 投资开始从软件延伸到家庭安防等实体服务，数据与入口价值是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.

stories.title: Meta 低调推出 AI 时尚应用 Style Sketch
stories.sourceTitle: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
stories.summary: Meta 上线 AI 时尚应用 Style Sketch，可连接 Instagram 用已分享照片构建虚拟衣橱，也支持拍照、短视频或相册上传手动添加单品。应用把社交图片转化为时尚管理工具。
stories.analysis: Meta 借 Instagram 视觉数据试水 AI 消费应用，电商与广告变现想象空间更大。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

stories.title: Mistral 发布万亿参数模型权重，主打网络安全
stories.sourceTitle: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
stories.summary: Mistral 发布其万亿参数 AI 模型的权重，并称新模型能让组织对网络防御获得闭源模型无法提供的控制力。开源权重策略瞄准安全敏感场景。
stories.analysis: 安全领域更看重可审计与自主控制，开放权重可能成为 Mistral 的差异化卖点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

stories.title: Granola 新增听写功能，与 Wispr 正面竞争
stories.sourceTitle: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
stories.summary: 在 Wispr 为听写应用加入会议笔记后，Granola 为其会议记录工具增加听写功能，语音 AI 工具的功能边界继续互相渗透。两家公司开始争夺同一语音工作流。
stories.analysis: 语音 AI 竞争从单点功能转向会议全流程，整合体验决定留存。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

stories.title: NYT Cooking 应用测试 AI 食谱修改功能
stories.sourceTitle: The NYT Cooking app is testing AI recipe modifications
stories.summary: 《纽约时报》正在为 Cooking 应用测试 AI 食谱修改功能，可推荐替代食材等修改方式，并在用户中引发讨论。AI 开始进入家庭烹饪的内容互动。
stories.analysis: 内容型应用引入生成式 AI 需平衡实用性、版权与用户信任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The New York Times is testing a new AI feature for its Cooking app that helps users to modify recipes, and it has sparked some drama among users. Last Friday, NYT Cooking senior editor Genevieve Ko announced the feature, which can be used to recommend substitu

stories.title: AI 数据中心扩张波及亚利桑那州水资源
stories.sourceTitle: AI has come for Arizona’s water
stories.summary: The Verge 报道亚利桑那州沙漠中的数据中心的巨型设施，这些算力支撑手机、电脑、流媒体、搜索和聊天机器人等服务。AI 基础设施扩张正把用水压力推到台前。
stories.analysis: 算力增长的环境成本将越来越成为数据中心选址与公共政策的约束。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A hulking gray giant rises from the desert. Inside, engineers create the force behind our phones and computers and appliances, our streaming services and search engines and chatbots and vibe-coded apps and websites. The complex is simultaneously massive and sq

stories.title: 美国调查针对 NVIDIA CEO 的中国间谍图谋
stories.sourceTitle: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: 据《纽约时报》消息，美国曾调查一起针对 NVIDIA CEO 的中国间谍图谋；一名被指非法向中国出售 NVIDIA 芯片的新加坡 AI 云公司高管也可能涉间谍活动。事件牵动芯片出口管制与国家安全。
stories.analysis: AI 芯片已成为地缘政治焦点，企业高管与供应链合规风险上升。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

stories.title: 前 Palantir 高管创办 Dream，获 a16z 1700 万美元做建筑 AI 世界模型
stories.sourceTitle: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
stories.summary: 前 Palantir 高管创立 Dream，获 a16z 1700 万美元融资，构建面向建筑业的 AI 世界模型。该模型基于真实物理和建筑标准，并用美国许可档案中超过 1 亿平方英尺建筑数据训练。
stories.analysis: 垂直世界模型若结合行业规范与真实数据，可能比通用 LLM 更适合工程场景。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

stories.title: 做迷你应用的 AI 智能体 Wabi 融资后估值达 12.5 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
stories.summary: AI 应用 Wabi 现自称“个人智能体”，宣布以 12.5 亿美元估值完成 5500 万美元融资。该公司主打由 AI 智能体构建迷你应用。
stories.analysis: 个人智能体赛道估值升温，但需要证明从生成小工具到持续使用的商业闭环。
stories.sourceExcerpt: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.

stories.title: Ropes & Gray 与 OpenAI 开发交易尽调 AI
stories.sourceTitle: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
stories.summary: Ropes & Gray 正与 OpenAI 合作开发用于交易尽职调查的 AI，律师会先审阅分组文档、摘要和报告，再向客户提供建议。律所把 AI 嵌入文档密集型尽调流程。
stories.analysis: 法律 AI 的落地重点不是替代律师，而是压缩尽调中的文档审阅成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

stories.title: Deepgram 收购 Pipecat 开发商 Daily，强化语音 AI 基础设施
stories.sourceTitle: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Deepgram 收购 Pipecat 背后的 Daily，以增强语音 AI 基础设施能力。借助 Pipecat，Deepgram 可能更深入理解实时语音和视频基础设施。
stories.analysis: 语音 AI 竞争向上游实时通信基础设施延伸，整合能力将影响开发者体验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

stories.title: Amazon 更新 Alexa，可管理购物清单、订阅和配送说明
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
stories.summary: Amazon 更新 Alexa，用户可通过语音创建和管理购物清单、查看清单内容、添加或编辑商品，还能管理订阅并更新配送说明。Alexa 进一步承担家庭购物与订阅管理。
stories.analysis: Alexa 正从语音助手转向家庭事务执行层，电商闭环是其优势。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

stories.title: OpenAI 介绍如何检测前沿模型失准与智能体越权行为
stories.sourceTitle: How we detect frontier model misalignment
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示采用分层监控检测前沿模型失准和未经授权的智能体行为，以便在事件升级前介入。文章披露其模型行为监控思路。
stories.analysis: 前沿模型越自主，实时监控与响应机制越成为安全部署的前提。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.

stories.title: Adam Mosseri：围绕 AI 的负面情绪还会变得更糟
stories.sourceTitle: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
stories.summary: Instagram 负责人 Adam Mosseri 在采访中承认，很多人确实不喜欢 AI，且不止年轻人与创意工作者；他还回应了大学生在毕业典礼上嘘科技 CEO 的现象。他预计对 AI 的负面情绪会进一步加剧。
stories.analysis: AI 产品扩张若忽视公众情绪，可能遭遇更强的社会反弹与信任赤字。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Asked about AI and the trend of college students booing tech CEOs at graduation ceremonies, Instagram head Adam Mosseri acknowledged in an interview that a lot of people really don't like AI, and it's not just young people and creatives. Appearing on the Colin

stories.title: Akai 拥抱 vibe coding 改机，推出开源 MPC
stories.sourceTitle: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
stories.summary: Akai 尚未正式发布 MPC Sample Key，但已展示改机社区通过 vibe coding 制作的项目，并让黑客和自定义固件开发者提前访问。硬件厂商开始接纳用户自发修改。
stories.analysis: 开放改机可激发社区创新，但也考验厂商对固件安全与生态治理的掌控。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The MPC Sample Key isn't even formally announced yet, but Akai is already showing off what the modding community is cooking up through vibe coding. Akai has decided to embrace the explosion of hackers and custom firmware developers by giving them early access

stories.title: OpenAI 探讨 AI 如何进入组织架构：在下属、旁边与之间
stories.sourceTitle: The future of the firm
stories.summary: OpenAI 发文讨论 AI 可能如何进入公司组织架构，位于员工之下、旁边以及人与人之间。文章关注 AI 对未来企业分工与协作方式的影响。
stories.analysis: AI 进入组织图不只是工具部署，更会重塑管理幅度与责任边界。
stories.sourceExcerpt: How AI might enter the org chart—beneath, beside, and between us.

stories.title: Chainguard 推出面向 AI 编码智能体的安全工作区与安全校验能力
stories.sourceTitle: Chainguard 推出面向 AI 编码智能体的安全工作区与安全校验能力
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道，Chainguard 推出面向 AI 编码智能体的安全工作区与安全校验能力。该方向针对智能体写代码时的权限、隔离与验证需求。
stories.analysis: AI 编码智能体要进入企业，安全边界和产物校验比生成速度更关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: 24 万元开卖，理想重造 i6，李想称目标全球畅销
stories.sourceTitle: 24万开卖！理想重造i6，李想：目标全球畅销
stories.summary: 理想在今年以来最后一场发布会上推出重造的 i6，售价 24 万元起，自研电池和芯片全部上车。李想称目标是全球畅销。
stories.analysis: 理想把自研电池与芯片下放到走量车型，意在用垂直整合打全球市场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 理想今年最后一场发布会，自研电池芯片全部上车

stories.title: Qwen3Guard 发布：面向 token 流的实时安全防护
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen 团队发布 Qwen3Guard，这是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基础模型针对安全分类微调，可对 token 流进行实时安全防护。它面向生成过程中的即时风险识别。
stories.analysis: 实时 token 级防护适合智能体与流式生成，但误判与延迟仍需平衡。
